The 'term of the award' is the period during which the option/award is exercisable (e.g., 'The term of any stock option awards... is ten years' = ExpirationPeriod). The 'vesting period' is the requisite service period over which the award vests (e.g., 'amortized... over the requisite service period, which is generally the vesting period' = VestingPeriod). When text mentions 'years' in the context of the award's term or exercisability, map to ExpirationPeriod, NOT VestingPeriod. Only map to VestingPeriod when the text explicitly references the service period, vesting schedule, or requisite service over which the award vests.
